name: OpenVibe.Pics
description: OpenVibe.Pics is the picture host of the OpenVibe network, an open and ad-free alternative to Imgur: upload a picture and get a link to share or embed anywhere (the page, the direct link, Markdown, BBCode and HTML), with albums. Every picture is re-encoded with its GPS position and camera details removed, served unlisted (only people with the link see it), and anyone can report one; staff takedowns keep the same picture from coming back. Uploading takes a free OpenVibe account.

pillars.title: Upload & share
pillars.text: Drop, paste or choose pictures and get links to share and embed anywhere, alone or in albums.

pillars.title: Clean files
pillars.text: Every picture is re-encoded: location and camera details are removed before anyone sees it.

pillars.title: Any size, any format
pillars.text: Every picture also comes 320 to 2560 pixels wide, as WebP, AVIF, JPEG or PNG, each with a link of its own.

pillars.title: Alt text
pillars.text: Say what a picture shows for people who cannot see it, or let AI draft it; every embed carries it.

pillars.title: Safe by default
pillars.text: Unlisted links, a report button on every picture, and takedowns that stay down.

faq.question: Who can see my pictures?
faq.answer: Only people with the link: every picture is unlisted. Share it as its page or a direct link, or embed it with Markdown, BBCode or HTML.

faq.question: Does a picture keep where it was taken?
faq.answer: No. Every upload is re-encoded with its GPS position and camera details removed before anyone sees it.

faq.question: Can I get other sizes or formats?
faq.answer: Yes. Every picture also comes 320 to 2560 pixels wide as WebP, AVIF, JPEG or PNG, each with a link of its own.

faq.question: Do I need an account?
faq.answer: To upload, yes: a free OpenVibe account. Opening a shared picture needs none.

faq.question: What if a picture breaks the rules?
faq.answer: Anyone can report it, and a staff takedown keeps the same picture from being uploaded again.
